item.title: Rangers 3, Blues 2 - Ozark Radio News
item.description: NEW YORK — Igor Shesterkin made 19 saves and the New York Rangers ended a four-game losing streak, defeating the St. Louis Blues 3-2 at Madison Square Garden on Monday. Jim Montgomery says he believes the Blues took a step back in Monday’s loss to the Rangers.
